shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work/hauling/medical/power/pipes/climate, stairs/ladders/elevators, opt-in vertical threats, caravan/trade/launch world integration, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. DBH + VEF PipeSystem soft compat; Reverse Commands soft compat (reflection-only).
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Basement solid mineable rock, thick-roofed, 12C.
- Animal policy (conservative): pets follow master, obedient pets get send gizmos, non-pen unrestricted pets cross for food; pen animals never.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.

## Vertical transport
- Stairs (1x), ladder (1.6x), grand staircase 2x2 (0.6x, quality scales climb), elevator (0.35x, power bridge, Extend gizmos, two-hop rides).
- Climb = 90t x type x quality x slider. All minifiable (uninstall collapses far side). Bomb >= 40 punches constructed rooftops. Giddy-Up mounted riders blocked.
- Stairs do NOT unroof anything below. Sky-side landing platforms (footprint+1) are RoofSurface, exempt from air-reversion while stairs stand.
- T9 VERTICAL UTILITY LINKS (Building_ABUtilityLink : Building_ABStairs, ext utilityOnly): full counterpart lifecycle but never pawns (excluded inside NearestUsableStairs), no float menu, no climate exchange. AB_VerticalConduitUp/Down: Power tab, 20 steel, Electricity, CompABPowerBridge. AB_VerticalWaterPipeUp/Down: DBH patch-gated, Hygiene tab, research mirrors DBH (Plumbing under dbhlitemode). ABPipeCompat routes per-def flags (bridgeWater/bridgeVef); VEF nets remain stairs-bridged.
- Migration diagnostics: verbose-log lines at each TryTowards decision.

## Sky surface model (round-10 final 2026-07-19)
- Owned terrains: AB_OpenAir (see-through, impassable), AB_RoofSurface (corrugated steel), AB_MountainTop (walkable cap; overlay is the visual).
- COVERED-BELOW rule (LevelSync.CoveredBelow): constructed roof below, OR artificial impassable edifice supporting an adjacent constructed roof - steel to the OUTER wall edge. Roof events re-sync 8 neighbors; wall-only changes converge on the sweep.
- MOUNTAIN CAP RENDERING (SectionLayer_ABMountainCap): vanilla fog material clones (fully-fogged vertex colors) so cap and fog are pixel-identical. Two runtime-derived queues (body low, wall-facing rim cutout+1). Overlap-free 3x3 tiling; edifice cells plain base quad. Regen on Terrain|Buildings; mining reveals with no regen.
- MINED FLOORS: leave-terrain kept as marker; overlay fills in source rock's wall/edge color (LevelSync.TryGetMinedRockColor).
- Mountains: mass erodes one step to walkable unfogged ledge; fog deep interior only (radius-2). Ore lumps (ABOreGen 6/10k).
- Sync self-heal: subscription retry (250t) + ReconcileRooftops (FinalizeInit + 2000t), platform-exempt; natural roofs generation-time only.

## See-below renderer
- Static pass: lower map's section meshes via cloned materials in a runtime-derived queue band. Dynamic pass: ONE-WAY MIRROR (unroofed, unfogged, in view, under open air).
- Air-cells light mask (night cap 0.45); silhouettes suppressed; ceiling hints; far clip 70. Weather decider suppressed on pocket levels.

## Systems (T0-T10 verified in-game 2026-07-19)
- Logistics: outbound haul + inbound fetch + demand pull + export pinning + carried-cargo delivery. Column-aware stuff picker.
- Needs: rest/food across column. Medical rescue three ways: auto work-giver, emergency work migration (pre-check before cooldown, own 600t cooldown), assignment-free forced float-menu rescue (verified). Capture via float menu. All ride CarriedIntent through StairTransfer.
- One-colony UI: tables append other levels; colonist bar per column; level buttons; camera preserved; beds alert aggregated.
- Power/pipes/climate bridges per link; ABPendingOrders replay (5000t expiry, also used by caravan joins).

## T8 threat opt-ins (implemented, pending verification)
- Divert already-fired surface incidents; pacing/points vanilla. Toggles default OFF + chance slider (25%).
- Infestations -> basement: prefix on IncidentWorker_Infestation.TryExecuteWorker, validated TryFindCell.
- Drop raids -> sky: prefix on TryResolveRaidSpawnCenter of the four drop arrival workers; skips quest raids, preset centers, sieges, non-hostiles; validates drop room.
- HOSTILE DESCEND AI (guard hostileMove): 250t pocket scan behind AnyHostileActiveThreatTo gate; idle humanlike/mech hostiles with no reachable target (max 8 CanReach probes) take stairs toward ground; StairTransfer releases map-scoped lord (Notify_PawnLost ExitedMap) and joins/creates LordJob_AssaultColony on arrival. Insects never cross.

## T11 world integration (implemented 2026-07-19, pending verification)
- Settings: columnWealth (default ON), worldIntegration (default ON). Guard: world.
- TILE IDENTITY: postfix on WorldObject.Tile gives our PocketMapParents the column ground's tile (filter: __result invalid + is PocketMapParent + our column). Map.Tile routes through it (MapInfo.Tile => parent.Tile), so transport pod/shuttle launches from the sky level, range math, and trader distances all just work. Foreign pocket maps untouched.
- COLUMN WEALTH: postfixes on Map.PlayerWealthForStoryteller (+ PlayerPawnsForStoryteller) aggregate linked levels into the ground map using the vanilla home formula (items + 0.5 buildings + pawns); children keep their own getters; skipped in fixedWealthMode. Closes the z-level wealth-hiding exploit. Vanilla already redirects pocket incident targets to sourceMap, so no double count.
- CARAVANS: AllSendablePawns postfix lists column FREE COLONISTS (plain caravan calls only, transporter groupID calls excluded). StartFormingCaravan prefix trims off-surface picks from the map-scoped lord (all-off-surface = reject with message); postfix sends each trimmed pawn down the stairs with an ABPendingOrders join (AddPawn into LordJob_FormAndSendCaravan on arrival; validates lord alive, pawn ok). Animals/prisoners on other levels: walk them down first (v1).
- TRADE: AllLaunchableThingsForTrade postfix concatenates column beacons (recursion impossible: acts on ground only). LaunchThingsOfType prefix drains debt level by level (reentrancy flag, vanilla per-level calls). GetCommTargets postfix lets pocket-level consoles hail surface passing ships; purchases still drop at the surface.
- SETTLEMENT LOSS: vanilla loss semantics + extra confirmation counting column colonists (prefix chain on SettlementAbandonUtility.TryAbandonViaInterface, mirrors the archotech pattern). Pocket maps die with the ground map NATIVELY: vanilla Game.DeinitAndRemoveMap destroys pocket children whose generatorDef has destroyOnParentMapAbandoned (default true; now explicit in AB_Basement/AB_Sky defs). No custom cleanup code.

## Performance architecture
- ABGuard plain-bool switches; AnySkyLevels gate; NearestUsableStairsCached memo. Recurring: weather 150t, pipes/climate 250t, power 10t hash, rooftop sweep 2000t, hostile scan 250t pocket-only. Zero recurring cost with no levels. WorldObject.Tile postfix filters on __result.Valid first (one check for real world objects).

## Compat
- DBH + VEF bridges; Reverse Commands; Fluffy Animal Tab; Declutter UI; Giddy-Up; incompatibleWith MultiFloors + ZLevels1.1; RimThreaded unsupported; foreign pocket maps read as level-0.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Floating rim/cap cells on natural roof loss (rare); sky projectile dim; tall below-sprites clip at rooftop edges; wall-only edits converge on sweep; mined-floor hard tint edges; bill radius vs stairs delivery; couples as singles in beds alert; RC direct links only; restaurants per-level; stuff picker direct links only; doctor pile-on window.
- T8: fleeing/kidnapping raiders exit only via descend; mounted Giddy-Up raiders never descend; basement insects do not resurface.
- T9: VEF nets bridge at stairs only; vertical links can open a level like stairs.
- T11: caravan items surface-only (goods must be hauled/exported down first); animals/prisoners not listed cross-level; purchases drop at surface; pod loading (transporters) lists surface pawns only; Odyssey gravship interactions with pocket levels unsupported/untested.

## Tranche plan
- T0-T10 DONE + verified. Round-11 float-menu rescue VERIFIED; emergency migration pending verification.
- T8 + T9 + T11 (all five items: wealth, caravans, settlement-loss warning, rooftop launches, column trade): IMPLEMENTED, compiling, pending in-game verification.
- Next: big verification relaunch, then T5 publishing prep. Backlog: VEF per-net shafts, caravan items/animals cross-level.

## Status
T8 + T9 + T11 implemented and compiling. One verification relaunch covers: round-10 visuals, emergency rescue, threat diversion + descend, vertical links, wealth aggregation, cross-level caravan, rooftop pod launch, basement beacon trade, abandon warning.
